description: This file contains the PHP class EmailSubscriberDao, which handles data access operations related to email subscribers and email notifications within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting email subscriber data, as well as querying email subscription entities.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for EmailSubscriber entities, providing methods to interact with the database for email subscription data.

methods.name: getEmailSubscribersByEmailSubscriptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of EmailSubscriber objects associated with a specific email subscription ID, applying optional search filters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberByEmailSubscriptionIdPaginator
methods.description: Builds and returns a Paginator object for email subscribers filtered by email subscription ID and search parameters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberListCountByEmailSubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the count of email subscribers associated with a specific email subscription ID, considering the search filters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionById
methods.description: Fetches an EmailNotification entity by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: saveEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Persists an EmailSubscriber entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmailSubscriber by its ID and subscription ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingEmailSubscriberIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing email subscriber IDs from a provided list.

methods.name: deleteEmailSubscribersByIds
methods.description: Deletes email subscribers by their IDs and returns the number of deleted records.
